verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs give a concrete bring-up path: a one-line MCP install command using an API key, and the Sai API flow of sending a plain-language task that Sai completes on a cloud Windows computer. However, no quickstart page or step-by-step install-to-first-task guide is evidenced, and no hands-on run confirms the docs alone get a developer to a completed task. Missing for 10: an explicit quickstart guide, documented steps to obtain an API key and provision a machine, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a first completed task from the docs alone.

support.subject: As a developer, I get from install to a first completed device task using the quickstart docs alone

citations.quote: claude mcp add sai -e SAI_API_KEY=sapi_YOUR_KEY -- npx -y @simular-ai/sai-mcp
send a task in plain language, and Sai completes it on a cloud Windows computer.
